changeLog.change: Registered supplied IDs; fetched public GTM container200 and confirmed existing G-8Y34NXQMMK destination, auto page/history/form/contact settings. Use one GTM loader, consent-first public scope, and full document navigation while tags are loaded so listeners cannot persist into private pages. No admin Google-account or live-commerce release authorisation inferred.

Local browser proves no script before consent/essential-only, supplied GTM loads after grant and is absent after entering login. Local business API unavailable independently; no local business acceptance claimed. Browser tooling exposes DOM/tag load state but not network collection requests; GA4 receipt/Realtime reporting remains unverified without Google-account/collection diagnostics.
